evidence_rules.historical_truth_rule: An acceptance receipt preserves the facts as of its own closure. A later milestone may change the current disposition of an item recorded there; B1I-M01 is open in the B1 receipt and CLOSED_BY_B2 now. That is succession, not contradiction. Never edit a past receipt to match current status; record the new disposition in the newer receipt and in STATUS.md.
contradiction_procedure: identify the exact refs and snapshot dates of both documents
check Git ancestry to see which state is actually reachable from main
prefer the canonical evidence at the newer exact ref
state explicitly which document is stale and why
do not silently edit either document as part of an unrelated task
